einzeiler: Emmy-winning actor Rhea Seehorn reflects on her decades-long journey in theater and…
kurzfassung: Actor Rhea Seehorn joins the podcast to discuss her extensive career, from regional theater in Washington D.C. to her breakthrough roles on Better Call Saul and Pluribus. She opens up about overcoming severe anxiety, managing the unpredictable nature of the entertainment industry, and her lifelong passion for visual arts. The conversation also covers her upbringing in a military family and working alongside Owen Wilson on the series Stick.
stichpunkte: Rhea Seehorn reflects on her early days doing non-union theater and running crew in Washington D.C.
She discusses the grueling reality of auditioning for years and facing constant rejection regarding her appearance.
The conversation explores her deep-rooted passion for fine arts, painting, sculpting, and crafting miniatures.
She details her experience starring in Better Call Saul and living with her co-stars during production.
Seehorn explains the unique collaborative environment and writing style of creator Vince Gilligan.
She shares memories of her father's career in counterintelligence and his struggles with alcoholism.
She discusses starring in the Apple TV series Stick alongside Owen Wilson and reprising her role in Pluribus.

kapitel.titel: Childhood, Military Family, and Moving Around
The Long Road in D.C. Theater and New York
Working on Better Call Saul and Living with Co-stars

clips.hook: Considering faking one's own death just to see the audience reaction.
clips.text: The guest jokingly contemplates staging her own demise solely to observe whether she receives applause during the awards show tribute segment.

clips.hook: Being told the brutal truth by casting directors.
clips.text: A casting professional bluntly explained to the actor that despite her talent, producers would ultimately insist on casting someone conventionally attractive.

clips.hook: Finding the psychological anchor point for a difficult scene.
clips.text: The actor describes the precise mental transition used when waking up in distress, searching for denial before reality sets in.

beschreibung:
Rhea Seehorn (Stick, Pluribus, Better Call Saul) is an Emmy Award-winning actor. Rhea joins the Armchair Expert to discuss growing up with a counterintelligence agent for a father, getting a crash course in status symbols in Virginia Beach, and discovering acting through a college requirement. Rhea and Dax talk about sharing a house while shooting Better Call Saul, telling eight pages of story without a word of dialogue, and training to look like a golf pro for Stick. Rhea explains how perfectionism can turn errands into paralysis, why needing a day job never meant giving up acting, and what happens when the need to be right leaves no room for uncertainty.
